cards.title: Lions + Texans
cards.tier: Lower payout; higher raw price-implied probability than the reserves

legs.evidence: StatsNext (through Nov 5, updated Nov 7, 2:54 PM ET) and Football Database list Detroit 29.0 points/game (3rd) and 395.4 yards/game (1st); Miami 16.7 points/game (31st) and 290.0 yards/game (27th). ESPN scoreboard lists Detroit 5-2 and Miami 1-6 for the 1:00 PM EST Hard Rock Stadium game. Jared Goff is Detroit’s season passing leader and is not listed with a Week 9 game designation on the official injury report; that is not the same as a confirmed inactive-list start.
legs.remaining_checks: Official Week 9 report still lists Amon-Ra St. Brown QUESTIONABLE (rib). Sunday-morning reports from Tom Pelissero ("good to go") and Ian Rapoport (expected to play, via NFL.com's Week 9 pregame tracker and FantasyPros 8:02 AM EST) say he will play; that is still not official activation. NFL.com/Rapoport also report Miami RB Jaylen Wright (quad) won't play. Jacob Saylors (neck) and Sione Vaki (ankle) are also QUESTIONABLE. Jack Campbell, Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays, D.J. Reed and D.J. Wonnum remain OUT. Check final inactives around 11:30 AM EST. Open-Meteo near 1:00 PM EST: about 84°F, wind 4 mph, gusts 4 mph, precip ~1%; ESPN listed 86°F and partly sunny.
legs.lineup_status: Projected / final inactives not released; practice status and reporter notes are not confirmation of starting.
legs.weather_status: Outdoor Hard Rock Stadium. Rechecked Open-Meteo this review: ~84°F, light wind, almost no rain chance at 1:00 PM EST. Not a live stadium observation; refresh again before kickoff.

legs.evidence: StatsNext/Football Database list Houston 23.6 points/game versus 14.1 for the Chargers (32nd). Houston’s giveaway rate is 0.4 per game (fewest) against the Chargers’ 2.4 (most); those season rates through Nov 5 roughly match about a +3 versus about -6 turnover differential, which is descriptive, not a calibrated forecast. ESPN scoreboard: Houston 2-5 at Los Angeles 0-7, 4:05 PM EST at SoFi Stadium. C.J. Stroud is Houston’s listed passing leader and is not on the Week 9 out/questionable list.
legs.remaining_checks: Houston is only 2-5: scoring and turnover comparisons are descriptive, not a validated prediction. David Montgomery and Reed Blankenship remain OUT. Official latest Week 9 report: Chargers Kayode Awosika, David Njoku, Denzel Perryman and Brenen Thompson are QUESTIONABLE, not doubtful as the prior card summary said; Deane Leonard and Kendall Williamson remain OUT. Recheck final inactives around 2:35 PM EST and the current price. SoFi’s canopy is not a fully indoor stadium in ESPN’s listing; it does not eliminate every weather consideration.
legs.lineup_status: Projected / final inactives not released; practice status and reporter notes are not confirmation of starting.
legs.weather_status: SoFi Stadium has a canopy; ESPN lists the venue as not indoor. ESPN forecast snapshot: mostly sunny, 88°F. No separate live weather clearance.
